mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and housing starts indicate broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face demand contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline relative to prior 3-month average.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 600.0 thousand units indicate weak residential demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as housing sector weakness signals broader economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 380,000 million dollars indicate strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 380,000 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate < 0 and UNRATE > 9.0.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Inflation above 225.0 on the CPI index signals rising price pressures that may prompt monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 225.0.
